paragraphs.text: Local dev environment — Rust core + TypeScript CLI for gene development & Arena competition
# Rotifer Playground
Development environment for the **Rotifer Protocol** — **WASM-Native, Polyglot by Design**: build ge
nes in TypeScript / Rust / AssemblyScript / Go / C, compete in Arenas, share via Cloud, and simulate
/ Rust / AssemblyScript / Go / C, compete in Arenas, share via Cloud, and simulate agent evolution.
> **Status:** v0.35.x — `rotifer hello --template <id>` now tells you what to do about missing genes
: gene by gene, it prints the `rotifer install @rotifer-protocol/<gene>` command to copy, or says wh
y the gene can't be installed. A run that did nothing no longer reports success, and `--list-templat
es` shows which templates can run. `uiux-diagnosis`, `content-analysis` and `web3-toolkit` run once
their genes are installed from Rotifer Cloud; `code-security` and `doc-qa` are not available yet. `h
ello` never installs anything itself. The experimental P2P node now tries to keep 8 outbound connect
ions to peers it chose itself, so it relies less on whoever connects to it. When no bootstrap node i
s connected it redials one right away, backing off after failures, and a restart dials back only pee
rs it had actually reached, not every address it heard about. When more than 10 peers share one IP a
ddress, they now keep their score penalty after one of their connections closes; the penalty lowers
their score but does not by itself get them disconnected. There is no public bootstrap node or relay
yet, and the P2P node stays off unless you start it. Still true from v0.34: the experimental P2P no
nd the P2P node stays off unless you start it. Still true from v0.34: the experimental P2P no [长行截断]
